findings.note: Package directory layout never explicitly stated; FR-006-FR-009 depend on the assembled tree mirroring source-relative layout so apply_bundle resolves manifest paths identically from inside the package. Make explicit in plan/data-model so tasks cannot get it wrong.

detect-secrets directory-scan behavior is version-sensitive (historically enumerates git-tracked files; destination is deliberately not a git repo). Specify an explicit file list from the in-memory capture set or verify full-coverage behavior rather than relying on directory-walk semantics.

findings.section: Design S3 vs S1 step 6, S2 step 7, S5 verifier
findings.note: Internal inconsistency on metadata exclusion: S3 implies SNAPSHOT.json is listed in the inventory while S1/S2/S5 and the 151 count imply both SNAPSHOT.json and the marker are excluded. Correct S3 wording before tasks.

Import mechanism for underscore-private helpers from scripts/speckit_bootstrap.py is unspecified (scripts/ not described as importable); decide mechanism and coupling policy (pin via tests vs vendoring) explicitly.

Packaged installer's dry-run/update/conflict semantics never explicitly exercised from the package itself; one dry-run->install->update->conflict pass from the assembled package would close the gap cheaply; state in/out of scope.
Reconcile FR numbering for S4/S5 against the actual spec text so traceability stays clean.
Only SC-001 cited explicitly; add a short SC-to-check traceability table.
Self-verification claim slightly overstated: a tampered verifier can lie about its own digest; qualify rather than present as assurance.
